name: Visa Inc.
summary: Visa Inc. operates as a payments technology company in the United States and internationally. It operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. The company also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movemen
verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 8/9 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 79/100 (Top-Firma, aber zu teuer), Innovations-Score 35/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 473.14 USD (+11 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
